name: Velaryx

taming.description: Hold still on a sunlit fern frond while it circles; once it perches on your outstretched glove for three dawns in a row it accepts being ridden by smaller handlers' lures.

abilities.name: Compound Sight
abilities.description: Detects movement at long range and flags prey on the player's HUD.

abilities.name: Dive Snatch
abilities.description: Fast grab attack that pulls small prey from foliage.

wild_behavior: Patrols fixed hunting perches along stagnant pools at dawn, snatching insects and tiny amphibians in flight. Chases rivals out of its air column and is ambushed in turn by Paludon at the water's edge.

name: Chilodrax

taming.description: Scatter rotting log slabs along its trail for several days; it falls into step behind the handler, accepting a harness once its migratory route overlaps your base.

abilities.name: Litter Shredder
abilities.description: Converts plant debris into compost and fiber at double yield.

abilities.name: Segment Roll
abilities.description: Curls into a ring that blocks projectiles.

wild_behavior: Slowly migrates between logs, shredding leaf litter into rich soil that other creatures forage. Groups curl up when giant scorpions or Paludon approach.

name: Paludon

taming.description: Out-wait it in the shallows without flinching through three lunges; its stare-down ritual yields only to a handler who holds ground and then offers eel meat.

abilities.name: Bog Ambush
abilities.description: Submerged strike that grabs and drags prey into water.

abilities.name: Tremor Read
abilities.description: Senses footsteps through the mud within 20 metres.

wild_behavior: Lies half-submerged for hours at the swamp margin, striking whatever drinks. Defends a stretch of bank and tolerates Chilodrax migrating past.

name: Hylos

taming.description: Leave grubs in a hollow stump daily; it nests inside carried stumps and becomes a pocket companion.

abilities.name: Grub Finder
abilities.description: Reveals buried insects and eggs nearby.

abilities.name: Stump Slip
abilities.description: Hides in any hollow, becoming untargetable briefly.

wild_behavior: Forages through hollow lycopsid stumps for beetles, fleeing into them at any shadow overhead. Clusters share nest stumps in winter.

name: Scorpex

taming.description: Present a clean carapace-shaped shield for it to test its claws on; after enough harmless pinning bouts it treats you as a dominant clutch-mate.

abilities.name: Sand Trap
abilities.description: Digs a pit that immobilises passing prey.

abilities.name: Paralytic Sting
abilities.description: Sting that slows a target for a short time.

wild_behavior: Digs shallow burrows under roots and waits for tremors. Is avoided by almost every swamp creature after dark.

name: Cremaspis

taming.description: Stand in the shadow cast across its sail until it learns your warmth; feeding it only at dusk when sluggish builds rank.

abilities.name: Sail Flare
abilities.description: Raises its sail to intimidate and reduce enemy aggression.

wild_behavior: Basks at sunrise on red rocks to warm its sail, then hunts at midday. Competes with Gorgovar for waterholes and loses to larger packs.

name: Spinavela

taming.description: Plant shade cloths near its grazing grounds; it learns that handler camps are safe thermal refuges.

abilities.name: Heat Store
abilities.description: Stores sun and then radiates warmth to allies in cold zones.

wild_behavior: Moves in tight herds between seasonal ferns, sails aligned to the sun. Flares sails in coordinated colour waves to warn of Cremaspis.

name: Gorgovar

taming.description: Defeat it in a non-lethal tusk contest at a salt wallow; the pair bond transfers to the handler only after proving superior stamina.

abilities.name: Paired Flank
abilities.description: Gains damage when its mate or owner also targets the foe.

wild_behavior: Hunting pairs defend salt-wallow territories and ambush thirsty herbivores. Scutarch is hunted only when isolated.

name: Scutarch

taming.description: Offer mineral-rich salt blocks regularly; it adopts the base as a salt wallow and stays to guard.

abilities.name: Bone Shell
abilities.description: Heavy armor plates with high damage reduction.

abilities.name: Wall Formation
abilities.description: Herd members adjacent to it share its defense.

wild_behavior: Feeds in tight groups near salt springs, arranging itself in a ring when threatened. Calves are guarded in the center.

name: Burrowtusk

taming.description: Dig a small den beside its warren and leave tubers at the entrance; it adopts you as a warren neighbor.

abilities.name: Tuber Locator
abilities.description: Finds buried roots and ore-adjacent water.

abilities.name: Warren Alarm
abilities.description: Colony alerts nearby allies to danger.

wild_behavior: Lives in communal warrens beneath salt crusts and surfaces at dusk to graze. Survived harsh seasons by sleeping underground.

name: Bulwarkhorn

taming.description: Win a restrained head-pushing contest on the salt flat at dawn; once it yields, it will bear a handler's yoke and guard the camp.

wild_behavior: Rival males settle disputes with ritual head-butting; the herd shelters behind the dominant bull.

name: Pterygar

taming.description: Free it from a stranded salt pan and return it to the sea; it repays the rescue by following your tide pools.

abilities.name: Claw Snare
abilities.description: Grappling claw locks prey in place.

abilities.name: Silt Burst
abilities.description: Kicks up a cloud that blinds attackers.

wild_behavior: Hunts on tide flats, scuttling between sea and brackish ponds. Raids nests of shore dwellers at night.

name: Pallidrake

taming.description: Raise a clutch from a shared nest egg while keeping the whole hatchling brood together; the pack imprints on the handler as a pack-mate.

abilities.name: Relay Chase
abilities.description: Pack members take turns pursuing prey to exhaust it.

wild_behavior: Roves badlands in loud packs, driving small prey into dry washes. Packs scatter from Rauxis but mob lone juveniles of other species.

name: Prosaurex

taming.description: Offer pine tips from a raised platform; it rears to take them and slowly accepts a saddle after repeated gentle pressure.

abilities.name: Browse Reach
abilities.description: Harvests tall tree foliage and resin.

wild_behavior: Migrates along conifer valleys, standing on hind legs to browse. Herds move at dusk and keep sentries at the flanks.

name: Rauxis

taming.description: Prove dominance with a bait carcass that it tries to guard; non-lethal defeat on carcass grounds leads to submission.

wild_behavior: Apex stalker of badlands drainages; patrols dry riverbeds and drags kills to its den. Sleeps through midday heat.

name: Placeron

taming.description: Maintain a mud wallow near the base and refill it daily; the herd treats it as its own.

abilities.name: Tusk Dig
abilities.description: Digs for roots and shallow water.

abilities.name: Herd Ring
abilities.description: Boosts defense with nearby herd members.

wild_behavior: Lives in big herds around lake margins, wallowing in mud and uprooting shrubs. Calves are kept in the herd centre.

name: Nothogar

taming.description: Offer live fish at the shoreline from a boat; it learns the boat as a feeding station.

abilities.name: Shoal Herding
abilities.description: Drives fish into a dense ball for easier harvesting.

wild_behavior: Hunts in lakeshore groups, driving shoals and hauling out to rest on rocks. Avoids larger Rauxis at the banks.

name: Stenocollis

taming.description: Mimic the slow sweeping of reed blades with a long pole; it accepts the mimic as a mate-like partner and stays near.

abilities.name: Whip Neck
abilities.description: Long reach strike on fish and flying prey.

abilities.name: Reed Still
abilities.description: Stays motionless and becomes harder to detect.

wild_behavior: Stands motionless in shallows, then extends its neck to snap fish. Dozes on mudbanks and avoids deeper water.

name: Thalassarch

taming.description: Let its remora-like cleaner fish nest on your boat hull; the giant tolerates the vessel as part of its pod and lets riders board.

abilities.name: Suction Gulp
abilities.description: Draws in schools of squid and fish with a powerful gulp.

abilities.name: Ocean Song
abilities.description: Low calls guide allies over long distances.

wild_behavior: Cruises in slow pods, diving for squid shoals. Its song attracts followers and remora-like fish that clean its skin.

name: Dartwing

taming.description: Throw fish from a cliff-top perch daily; the flock gradually takes food from your hand.

abilities.name: Skim Snatch
abilities.description: Quick grab of fish at the water surface.

abilities.name: Flock Swirl
abilities.description: Distracts enemies with a rotating flock.

wild_behavior: Roosts in cliff colonies and skims lakes for fish at dawn. Colonies mob egg raiders loudly.

name: Burrowfur

taming.description: Dig a mock burrow and place insects within; it moves in and becomes a loyal den-mate.

abilities.name: Sniff Burrow
abilities.description: Locates buried insects, fungus and roots.

abilities.name: Torpor Curl
abilities.description: Enters torpor, avoiding detection and conserving energy.

wild_behavior: Digs paired burrows in dry soil and forages at dusk. Seasonally sleeps in torpor through the dry season.

name: Fringeglider

taming.description: Hold still beneath a conifer with a mealworm until it glides onto your shoulder.

abilities.name: Fringe Glide
abilities.description: Long glides between trees without stamina cost.

abilities.name: Bark Cling
abilities.description: Sticks to any bark and ledges.

wild_behavior: Glides between conifer trunks hunting beetles, using elongated back fringes for braking. Hides under bark flakes when raptors pass.

name: Rhynchon

taming.description: Scatter seed-ferns near a dust bath at your base; the herd arrives within a season.

abilities.name: Beak Scoop
abilities.description: Scrapes soil for roots and seed ferns.

wild_behavior: Bulk grazers in dense dust-bathing herds, scraping up seed ferns. Easy prey for Pallidrake packs but strong in numbers.

name: Caelotitan

taming.description: Maintain stable feed groves; the giants slowly treat an area with fresh foliage as part of their route and permit loading platforms.

abilities.name: Tower Browse
abilities.description: Reaches treetop foliage unavailable to others.

wild_behavior: Moves in slow family groups between forest edges; calves are hidden within the herd. Predators rarely test a healthy adult.

name: Tergoplax

taming.description: Present your shield to its tail swing and endure rounds of harmless blows without retreating; it then accepts the handler as herd-leader.

abilities.name: Plate Flush
abilities.description: Plates flush red to threaten, reducing enemy aggression.

wild_behavior: Grazes in small groups and uses plate colors for signals. Defends against Lacerax by turning and swinging tails.

name: Lacerax

taming.description: Outlast its stalking bluff charge at the edge of a carcass, standing tall; after a feeding standoff it concedes rank and follows.

wild_behavior: Ambushes sauropod calves and carcass-feeds; rival adults sometimes gather at big kills. Roars from ridgelines at dusk.

name: Pipsnatch

taming.description: Trade shiny trinkets and bugs; the pack adopts the handler's camp as its hunting base.

abilities.name: Scrap Scamper
abilities.description: Steals small items from enemies' loot.

abilities.name: Pack Chirp
abilities.description: Warns of threats around the base.

wild_behavior: Small flocks forage under conifers, grab lizards and scavenge. Fleeing from anything larger.

name: Eoalis

taming.description: Mimic its song on a bone whistle until it answers and perches on your hand.

wild_behavior: Pairs hop from branch to branch and do short flights between trees. Sings at dawn to defend its tree from rivals.

name: Skimtail

taming.description: Leave fish on a rock at nest sites; flocks become used to the handler.

abilities.name: Gaff Dip
abilities.description: Needle teeth catch fish near the water surface.

wild_behavior: Colonies nest on archipelago cliffs and fish lagoons at dawn. Thieves of each other's catches.

name: Orbitus

taming.description: Swim alongside in synchrony and echo its body language until it accepts your lead.

abilities.name: Dusk Dive
abilities.description: Dives to high depth to hunt squid.

wild_behavior: Pods dive to hunt squid at dusk; their huge eyes hold deep-sea predators at bay.

name: Kraxmaw

taming.description: Outswim it in a long, calm chase through deep water while carrying fish offerings; exhaustion and respect make it yield.

abilities.name: Skull Crush
abilities.description: Bite that crushes armor and bone.

wild_behavior: Sole ruler of its archipelago waters, patrolling channels and attacking anything that wades. Even other apex predators avoid its territory.

name: Fernrunner

taming.description: Move slowly with open palms and let it graze alongside; it accepts riders after a few runs together.

wild_behavior: Herds graze open prairies with sentinels on mounds. When alarmed they flee in a sudden spurt, zigzagging.

name: Flagellun

taming.description: Cultivate fern fields and let herds graze them across seasons; they accept pack loads after several seasons.

abilities.name: Whip Crack
abilities.description: Sonic tail crack that stuns small foes.

abilities.name: Long March
abilities.description: Carries heavy loads for long distances.

wild_behavior: Moves across prairies in lines, combing low ferns. Tail cracks warn predators and keep the herd aligned.

name: Scelida

taming.description: Leave low cycads in a quiet glade; it returns each dusk and settles at the base.

wild_behavior: Lives at forest edges grazing low cycads. Hunkers under its armor when threatened, relying on scutes.

name: Vorathrax

taming.description: Offer a series of increasingly large kills at the territory boundary over many days; it concedes the territory to the handler only after you have shown no fear at the border.

abilities.name: Bone Crush
abilities.description: Bite that cracks armor and bone.

abilities.name: Scent Track
abilities.description: Follows wounded prey over huge distances.

wild_behavior: Patrols huge territories along forest edges, scavenging and hunting hadrosaur herds. Neighbouring territories are marked by roars.

name: Cranioplax

taming.description: Out-stand it in a slow, head-lowered parley where you place a hand on its frill without retreat; it then accepts the handler as its calf-guard.

wild_behavior: Herds march through forest, calves at the center. Males spar by locking horns without serious injury.

name: Falxira

taming.description: Raise the pack's eggs under a heated stone nest, then play fetch with hatchlings; the pack bonds with the handler's household.

abilities.name: Sickle Pin
abilities.description: Pins prey with a curved claw and holds it.

abilities.name: Relay Flank
abilities.description: Pack members flank prey in teamwork.

wild_behavior: Coordinated packs hunt young herbivores and use wing feathers to balance and signal. Packs share territory with kin groups.

name: Gravitor

taming.description: Leave heaps of mineral-rich ash plants; its defensive bluff relaxes after you eat nearby in a non-threatening posture.

abilities.name: Tail Club
abilities.description: Heavy club swing that cracks bone.

wild_behavior: Grazes volcanic slopes alone or in pairs and ignores predators. It forages ash-fertilised shrubs.

name: Sonocrest

taming.description: Answer its crest calls with a horn, matching rhythm for days; it carries a rider once your calls form a stable dialogue.

abilities.name: Crest Trumpet
abilities.description: Long-range call alerts or rallies allies.

abilities.name: Chorus Call
abilities.description: Calls from herd members grant buffs.

wild_behavior: Huge herds travel river deltas, calling constantly. Calls change with the seasons and warn of Vorathrax.

name: Hydrasail

taming.description: Provide an endless supply of catch near a river bar and wade out without bait; it comes to see your presence as harmless.

abilities.name: Net Snap
abilities.description: Whips fish out of water with its jaws.

abilities.name: Sail Display
abilities.description: Raises sail to threaten or attract mates.

wild_behavior: Wades the delta and hunts fish with sweeps of the snout, but also scavenges carcasses. Lone adult drives out rivals.

name: Cirrothrone

taming.description: Perform its courtship hops and bill clatters in a specified pattern; if you match them, it accepts the handler as a partner.

abilities.name: Thermal Ride
abilities.description: Soars for long periods without stamina cost.

wild_behavior: Soars on volcanic updrafts and stalks the ground for prey. Pairs nest on high ledges and defend them.

name: Thermalwing

taming.description: Feed it fish from a cliff perch; it accepts an anchor harness once trust builds.

wild_behavior: Colonies ride coastal winds and scoop fish. They share cliffs with large gulls and compete for nest ledges.

name: Brinegar

taming.description: Defeat it in a long tow-line contest from a ship; its pride yields only to a handler who matches its stamina.

abilities.name: Wake Read
abilities.description: Senses vibrations from ships and swimmers.

wild_behavior: Apex marine hunter that surges from deep water to take anything at the surface.

name: Tessaron

taming.description: Release jellyfish and kelp in a lagoon pen; it shelters there, and later tows boats willingly.

wild_behavior: Wanders reefs eating jellyfish and nesting on chalk beaches. Hatchlings are picked off by shore pterosaurs.

name: Cursorex

taming.description: Race beside it daily, matching pace, then slow down together; it accepts a rider after a few matched sprints.

wild_behavior: Fast herds roam floodplains and eat leaves, eggs and insects. They scatter in all directions when attacked.

name: Tholoram

taming.description: Spar with a padded stand; losing the headbutt duel gracefully gives it the confidence to follow the handler.

abilities.name: Dome Crash
abilities.description: Head ram that deals concussive damage.

wild_behavior: Stages ritual head-butting duels on ridges and defends slopes against rivals.

name: Orogant

taming.description: Accept its slow-moving caretaker fauna on your platforms; as it tolerates your riding platform, it will carry a whole camp over time.

abilities.name: Land Bridge
abilities.description: Carries a whole camp on its back.

wild_behavior: Slowly migrates between delta and forest, creating clearings and trails others use. Adults ignore all but very large predators.

name: Psittula

taming.description: Pass nuts to its beak with a gentle sling; it follows the sound of shells.

wild_behavior: Squeaky herds pick seeds and nuts, with juveniles clustering. Their chatter is used by other species as a safe signal.

name: Tetraptera

taming.description: Match its trilling calls with leaf drums; once it accepts the rhythm, it perches on the handler's shoulder.

wild_behavior: Glides from high branches to ambush small mammals and birds at dawn.

name: Falcarm

taming.description: Hold fruiting branches on a long pole while it plucks; it tolerates the handler working with it at the same tree.

abilities.name: Branch Hook
abilities.description: Pulls entire branches down to harvest fruit.

abilities.name: Claw Threat
abilities.description: Spreads long claws to deter attackers.

wild_behavior: Browses big trees with scythe-like claws and rears when threatened. It sleeps sitting up.

name: Clavirostra

taming.description: Mirror its dueting calls with a flute; it dances and eventually adopts the handler as its mate-partner.

wild_behavior: Mated pairs hunt in rainforest clearings, using sprints to catch prey. Duets echo across territories.

name: Anguicet

taming.description: Free it from fishing nets or stranding; it bonds with its rescuer for life.

wild_behavior: Elongated hunter patrols shallow seas and snaps up fish and young reptiles.

name: Colubrex

taming.description: Share a heated rock beside it for weeks without sudden movement; once it recognizes your thermal trace as safe, it consents to handling.

abilities.name: Constrict
abilities.description: Holds prey in coils and suffocates.

abilities.name: Heat Pit
abilities.description: Senses warm bodies in the dark.

wild_behavior: Lurks in warm river margins, lying submerged and striking at anything that comes to drink. Digests prey for weeks.

name: Eohoof

taming.description: Whistle softly while leaving fruit under cover; the herd gradually follows you into base.

wild_behavior: Slips between thickets in small herds, eating leaves and fruit and bolting in unison when predators near.

name: Nyctalis

taming.description: Provide a roosting rack of hollow logs in the base; the swarm will shelter there and share its sonar maps.

abilities.name: Swarm Drift
abilities.description: Creates a swirling cloud of distraction.

wild_behavior: Roosts in hollow trees by day and swarms through forest gaps at dusk, mapping the dark using echolocation.

name: Altimont

taming.description: Plant tall acacia-like groves at the base; it becomes a visitor and later a loyal grazer.

wild_behavior: Giant hornless rhino relative browsing in tall trees and wandering between woodlands. Calves hide beneath mothers.

name: Brontoplax

taming.description: Contest its nasal horn in a controlled clash in dust; accepting its pushes and answering with equal force is the way to rank.

abilities.name: Dust Roar
abilities.description: Roars that kick up blinding dust.

wild_behavior: Males clash in dusty arenas for dominance; herds guard watering holes. Serve as bodyguards to smaller grazers.

name: Dinoceron

taming.description: Maintain a muddy wallow with fresh fruits; it makes the base part of its home range.

wild_behavior: Browses river-edge forests and wallows in muddy pools. Males show off bony horns and sparring tusks.

name: Megadent

taming.description: Hold a slow parallel course beside it in open water for days while dragging whale-blubber bait; its stalking bluff fades once you show no prey behaviour.

abilities.name: Serrated Bite
abilities.description: Massive bite that causes severe bleeding.

wild_behavior: Hunts whales and giant reptiles, patrolling migration routes. Stays in open water during most of the year, nurseries in warm shallows.

name: Terragrade

taming.description: Offer branches pulled to its reach while keeping to its side; it places its claws on the handler's shoulder as a sign of acceptance.

abilities.name: Rear Brace
abilities.description: Rears on hind legs to defend.

wild_behavior: Browses tall trees alone, walking slowly and rearing to pull branches. Scares predators by raising its arms.

name: Spadetusk

taming.description: Dig a wide watering trough at the base and replenish it; the herd relocates.

abilities.name: Shovel Tusk
abilities.description: Digs water holes and uproots plants.

wild_behavior: Matriarch-led herds wander savannas, digging for water in dry seasons.

name: Carapaxon

taming.description: Offer fresh grass in a sheltered paddock; its shell opens and it accepts guard duties.

wild_behavior: Grazes in small groups and tucks into its shell when attacked. Mud wallows keep parasites down.

name: Aeroclast

taming.description: Lay out carrion in a courtship-like display; its ritual of exchanging gifts bonds it.

wild_behavior: Soars at high altitude searching for carcasses and defends nesting cliffs. Circles over dying herds.

name: Branchhorn

taming.description: Present salt and young shoots at its height; it accepts a saddle after regular rides.

wild_behavior: Herds roam the savanna eating leaves from tall trees. Males compete with branched horns.

name: Digdrome

taming.description: Plant a salt-lick garden; the herd adopts the area as its seasonal range and accepts packs.

wild_behavior: Large slow marsupial-like browsers travel along waterways, grubbing shrubs and trekking in mud.

name: Lanatusk

taming.description: Clear snow from grazing patches near the base through winter; the herd learns your camp is a feeding ground.

abilities.name: Tusk Snowplow
abilities.description: Clears snow and ice from paths.

wild_behavior: Matriarchal herds migrate across steppe and valleys; calves are encircled when wolves approach.

name: Monoceron

taming.description: Stand your ground against its bluff charge three times; if you hold without flinching, it follows you.

wild_behavior: Solitary grazers on steppe grasslands who charge intruders. Defend patches of grass.

name: Falcidens

taming.description: Raise a cub from an orphaned den; it imprints on the handler as a pride member.

wild_behavior: Small prides ambush big herbivores from tall grass. They use caves as dens.

name: Cinderlupus

taming.description: Raise a litter together with pack mates; pups imprint on the handler's household.

abilities.name: Howl Relay
abilities.description: Calls across long distances to gather pack mates.

wild_behavior: Packs hunt in relays across steppe; they share kills and keep a hierarchy.

name: Tallpaw

taming.description: Gain dominance in a long standoff over a fresh carcass without retreating; it will sit down to share.

wild_behavior: Wide-ranging solitary hunters and scavengers who steal kills from smaller predators.

name: Gnawmaw

taming.description: Mimic its laughing calls and join its greeting ritual; it accepts the handler as a clan member.

abilities.name: Bone Crack
abilities.description: Powerful bite breaks bone for marrow.

wild_behavior: Clans use cave dens and scavenge on kills from larger predators.

name: Coronag

taming.description: Share fodder within its antler display circle and avoid sudden motions; it permits riding.

wild_behavior: Herds roam open steppe; males grow massive antlers and fight at rut.

name: Saxifex

taming.description: Share salt on a ledge and remain still; it follows you along cliff paths.

abilities.name: Scree Run
abilities.description: Runs across loose rock without slipping.

wild_behavior: Nimble herds scale cliffs to eat alpine plants. They move higher in summer.

name: Sonovex

taming.description: Trade clicks in the dark with a bone clicker; as the pack learns your pattern, it guides the handler through caves.

abilities.name: Click Map
abilities.description: Echolocation outlines caves and hidden foes.

wild_behavior: Blind-ish descendants of troodontids who patrol karst galleries in clicking packs. Drive prey to dead ends and avoid noisy streams.

name: Caecoplax

taming.description: Tap a steady rhythm on tunnel walls; its trust grows and it digs where you tap.

abilities.name: Slab Shell
abilities.description: Heavy cover for allies in tunnels.

wild_behavior: Blind ankylosaur descendant that tunnels slowly through limestone eating root mats and fungus. Excavations become routes for other cave animals.

name: Pallidolm

taming.description: Place fish at the edge of a dark pool; it grows used to the scent and sleeps by the handler.

abilities.name: Scent Snap
abilities.description: Snap on prey found by smell.

wild_behavior: Lives in underground pools drifting for days, then snapping fish in sudden bursts.

name: Guanoptera

taming.description: Install perches in a quiet cave section; the colony adopts the base and offers sonar scouting.

abilities.name: Cave Sonar
abilities.description: Maps tunnels instantly in a wide radius.

wild_behavior: Hundreds roost on cave roofs and swirl out at night. Their guano feeds fungi and beetles below.

name: Emberstalk

taming.description: Avoid the glow of its heat-pit gaze and stay calm in front of a hot flare; after a feeding standoff it submits.

abilities.name: Heat Sight
abilities.description: Sees warm creatures in total darkness.

wild_behavior: Prowls warm lava tubes waiting beside vents for hot-blooded prey. Heat pits help it hunt in total dark.

name: Basaltodon

taming.description: Supply mineral salts and crushed obsidian; it settles in the base and processes ore for you.

wild_behavior: Grinds basalt and obsidian with gizzard stones, absorbing minerals. Leaves cavities lined with crystal dust.

name: Umbrapede

taming.description: Leave decaying fruit beside a lamp; it adopts your cave camp as a scavenger post.

wild_behavior: Cleans tunnel floors of carcasses and spores. Colonies move through lava tubes in slow, glowing processions.

name: Prismodon

taming.description: Offer small crystals from a geode; it hoards them in your pocket and returns for more.

abilities.name: Gem Stash
abilities.description: Stores gems in cheeks and delivers them.

wild_behavior: Small colonies gnaw geode crystals and squeak resonant calls. They hide stashes of gems in burrows.

name: Glimmerwing

taming.description: Reflect its wing glints with a polished crystal; it joins the display and perches on the handler.

abilities.name: Glint Flash
abilities.description: Blinding flash from its wing membranes.

wild_behavior: Pterosaur colonies cling to crystal ceilings and glide after cave moths. Their wings reflect light in mating displays.

name: Opalnaut

taming.description: Present a carefully held polished pearl while resisting its tentacle snares; it yields once it has tested your composure.

abilities.name: Tentacle Snare
abilities.description: Ensnares small prey and removes weapons.

wild_behavior: Crawls underwater along geode floors and snares fish and crustaceans with tentacles. Can retreat by jet.

name: Nyxfin

taming.description: Echo its click patterns underwater via a bone clacker; it recognises you as a pod member.

abilities.name: Current Ride
abilities.description: Rides currents with low stamina cost.

wild_behavior: Blind ichthyosaur descendants hunt in pods along flooded galleries, using echoes to find fish.

name: Umbrasuchus

taming.description: Defeat it in a non-lethal grappling duel on a sandbar and share an offering of eel meat; it then yields.

wild_behavior: Blind giant crocodilian lying in subterranean river bends, striking at tremors. Defends a stretch of river and its sandbar.

name: Sporodon

taming.description: Seed a fungus plot with mulch; it brings its herd to graze and accepts harvest duty.

abilities.name: Fungus Graze
abilities.description: Eats spores and fungus without harm.

wild_behavior: Herds follow fungal blooms and cultivate patches by spreading spores in dung. Relatives of beaked synapsids.

name: Penduloth

taming.description: Hang a hammock beside its roost; it accepts the handler to ride on its back.

abilities.name: Ceiling Hang
abilities.description: Hangs upside down on cave roofs and lets allies climb.

wild_behavior: Hangs from stalactites to graze hanging mats of lichen and roots. Very slow but strong, rarely noticed.

name: Pyrelasmus

taming.description: Defeat it in a heat-tolerant contest in warm water, offering a vent fish; it concedes only after you endure the vents.

abilities.name: Vent Ambush
abilities.description: Waits next to hydrothermal vents then surges.

wild_behavior: Deepwater predator in magma-heated seas. Hunts creatures that gather around vents.

name: Thermosyph

taming.description: Place cultured bacteria mats near it; it shares its vents and yields minerals.

abilities.name: Heat Pulse
abilities.description: Warms nearby allies in the cold deep.

wild_behavior: Rooted clusters line magma vents, filtering bacteria. Provide shelter for small deep-sea animals.

name: Scoriaclaw

taming.description: Show no fear when it clacks claws and offer a vent shrimp; it submits to the first handler who breaks its claw-bluff.

wild_behavior: Roams slag fields eating carrion and crustaceans. Burrows into hot ash to ambush.
